meta.description: Use this when setting up claude-mem on Cursor: local or remote worker, local host-login observer or remote cmem.ai inference.

copy.tagline: 在 Cursor 中完成本地或远程的记忆服务配置，让 AI 助手记住上下文。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在 Cursor 里编程，希望 AI 助手能跨会话记住内容。
copy.tagline_en: Set up a memory service for Cursor with local or remote options.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you code in Cursor and want your AI assistant to remember context.

howto.what: 在 Cursor 上装好 claude-mem:启动本地或远程 worker,由插件自带的 hooks 与 MCP(claude-mem-local 或 claude-mem-remote)负责读写记忆。观察者走远程推理或本机登录。
howto.when: 当你要在 Cursor 上搭建 claude-mem 时触发,包括选本地或远程 worker、本机登录观察者,或远程 cmem.ai 推理。

say.text: 帮我在 Cursor 上装 claude-mem,用默认的本地 worker
把 claude-mem 的观察者改成本机登录的方式
把 claude-mem 接到我自己的远程 worker 服务器

howto.what_en: Installs claude-mem on Cursor: starts a local or remote worker, with hooks shipped by the plugin and MCP servers (claude-mem-local or claude-mem-remote) handling memory. The observer uses remote inference or local host login.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you set up claude-mem on Cursor: choosing a local or remote worker, a local host-login observer, or remote cmem.ai inference.

say_en.text: Install claude-mem in Cursor with the default local worker
Switch the claude-mem observer to local host login
Point claude-mem at my own remote worker server
